svg.text: Aerolab Wind Tunnel — ACS550 Modbus RTU Wiring
ACS550-U1-046A-2 · 15 HP · 208–240 V 3PH · S/N 2121803289 · fw 3.13 · FTDI USB-RS485-WE direct to X1
Power and safety chain in red. Control path in teal. They never touch.
LOTO point · hardwired · never routed through software
EXISTING AEROLAB PANEL — speed pot + start/stop
lands on X1 AI1 and DI1…DI6 — verify before you touch anything
One row of 32 terminals. Teal = used. Grey = likely occupied by Aerolab. Hatched = present but not needed here.
J2 DIP switch sits beside these terminals
28 and 32 unused — no separate shield with this cable
par 1102 → EXT1 = Aerolab panel, EXT2 = Modbus
keeps manual control working for everyone else
Six conductors out of the cable. Three land, one is taped off, two bridge to engage the terminator.
Orange + Green into one ferrule → 29 · Yellow + Brown into one ferrule → 30
bridging Term 1/2 across the pair engages the cable's internal 120 Ω
Own knockout in the gland box. Do not tie this cable alongside the motor leads inside the enclosure.
Routing is your only noise mitigation with an unshielded 6 ft run — 8 in separation, cross at 90°.
Any parameter P is readable at wire address P − 1

g.text: Disconnect open, locked, tagged · wait 5 minutes minimum for the DC bus capacitors · verify dead at U1/V1/W1
Terminals 19–27 can carry external voltage even with the drive fully dead · the ACS550 auto-starts at power-up if a run command is present
